key_insight: HERD combines an evolving external harness with recursive distillation to acquire new capabilities while limiting catastrophic forgetting.
engineering_relevance: HERD could support continually updated engineering AI assistants, but the abstract provides no solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling validation.
method: Refine reusable skills in an external harness.
Retain high-residual examples in bounded memory.
Distill experience into model parameters using dual-anchor drift constraints.
evidence_signal: On the 25-stage TRACE+17 task stream under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while reporting the least forgetting and strongest general-capability retention.
watch_item: Transfer to mechanics applications remains untested in the abstract; retention of physical consistency would require separate evaluation.
paper_title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
